Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on Water and Power. Hearings held.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Primarily affects federal regulatory agency staff preparing reports and congressional committees receiving them.
dimensions.evidence: the Commission shall submit to Congress a report on the status of... licensing process for each new license

dimensions.assessment: Creates an administrative reporting requirement without altering licensing criteria or decisions.
dimensions.evidence: require the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to annually submit to Congress a report

dimensions.assessment: Negligible or administrative internal agency reporting costs not explicitly quantified.
Amends the Federal Power Act to add a single reporting requirement.
dimensions.evidence: Part I of the Federal Power Act (16 U.S.C. 792 et seq.) is amended by adding at the end the following: 'SEC. 37. ANNUAL LICENSING STATUS REPORT.'

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent annual reporting mandate.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this section, and annually thereafter

missing_information: Estimated administrative cost to FERC for compiling the annual report
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to submit an annual report to Congress detailing the status of ongoing hydropower relicensing and original licensing applications.
